text: OVERDOSAGE Acute systemic overdosage by inhalation is unlikely since ipratropium bromide is not well absorbed after inhalation at up to four-fold the recommended dose, or after oral administration at up to forty-fold the recommended dose. The oral LD 50 of ipratropium bromide ranged between 1,001 and 2,010 mg/kg in mice; between 1,667 and 4,000 mg/kg in rats; and between 400 and 1,300 mg/kg in dogs.
